title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: A soundboard‑type recording (source unknown) captures a gritty, youthful Jerry and a hellacious Brent solo, with Beat It Down the Line highlighted.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soulful, gritty playing that shows Jerry’s youthful chords and praise Brent Mydland’s angry, hellacious keyboard solo. The show also gets nods for a standout Beat It Down the Line, while no specific recording‑quality issues are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on performance (70% weight) and no reported recording problems (30% weight) lead to a high overall rating despite limited technical detail.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound clarity, mix balance or other technical aspects; focus was entirely on musical performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as soulful and gritty, showing his youthful chord work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent delivers an angry, hellacious solo that reviewers highlight.
